SELECT w.id,w.custom_id,w.title,a.id AS asset_id,a.name AS asset_name,w.status,w.priority, w.created_at,w.completed_on,w.archived,COALESCE(w.is_demo,false) AS is_demo, CASE WHEN w.status=3 AND w.completed_on IS NOT NULL AND w.completed_on>=w.created_at THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (w.completed_on-w.created_at)) END AS cycle_seconds, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM meter_trigger_execution me WHERE me.work_order_id=w.id AND me.company_id=w.company_id) AS meter_triggered FROM work_order w LEFT JOIN asset a ON a.id=w.asset_id AND a.company_id=w.company_id
ORDER BY w.created_at ASC,w.id ASC ORDER BY w.created_at DESC,w.id DESC
